campuses.title: Dubai Knowledge Park Campus
campuses.text: Новый кампус Heriot-Watt в Knowledge Park, торжественно открытый King Charles III в ноябре 2023. Все 6 школ под одной крышей: Engineering, Energy, Mathematics & Computing, Business, Textiles & Design, Social Sciences.

paragraphs: Heriot-Watt University Dubai is the Dubai campus of Heriot-Watt University, a Scottish public research university with roots going back to 1821. The Dubai campus opened in 2005, becoming the first overseas university branch in Dubai International Academic City. In 2021 the campus relocated to a purpose-built facility in Dubai Knowledge Park, which was officially opened by King Charles III on 30 November 2023.

The Dubai campus delivers more than 50 undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across six schools: School of Engineering and Physical Sciences, School of Energy, Geoscience, Infrastructure and Society, School of Mathematical and Computer Sciences, School of Social Sciences, School of Textiles and Design, and Edinburgh Business School. All degrees are awarded by Heriot-Watt University in the UK and meet the same academic standards as those on the Edinburgh campus.

With around 5,000 students from 115 nationalities, Heriot-Watt Dubai is the largest international university branch in the UAE. The university holds UK royal charter accreditation, KHDA licensing, and CAA accreditation from the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation, allowing graduates to work in both the UAE and globally.

Heriot-Watt Dubai received the Forbes Middle East 'Best University' award in 2019 and earned five-star KHDA ratings for three consecutive years (2019-2021). The university is strong in engineering, construction, energy, and Edinburgh Business School's MBA — programmes designed with deep ties to UAE industry and global Heriot-Watt alumni networks.
paragraphsRu: Heriot-Watt University Dubai — Dubai-кампус шотландского государственного исследовательского университета Heriot-Watt, корни которого уходят в 1821 год. Dubai-кампус открылся в 2005 году и стал первым зарубежным филиалом университета в Dubai International Academic City. В 2021 кампус переехал в специально построенное здание в Dubai Knowledge Park, которое торжественно открыл King Charles III 30 ноября 2023.

Dubai-кампус ведёт более 50 программ бакалавриата и магистратуры по 6 школам: School of Engineering and Physical Sciences, School of Energy, Geoscience, Infrastructure and Society, School of Mathematical and Computer Sciences, School of Social Sciences, School of Textiles and Design и Edinburgh Business School. Все дипломы выдаёт Heriot-Watt University UK и они равноценны дипломам Edinburgh-кампуса.

Около 5,000 студентов из 115 стран — Heriot-Watt Dubai является крупнейшим зарубежным филиалом университета в ОАЭ. Аккредитации: UK royal charter, KHDA, UAE CAA — выпускники могут работать в ОАЭ и по всему миру.

Forbes Middle East 'Best University' (2019), 5-star KHDA рейтинг 3 года подряд (2019-2021). Сильные направления: engineering, construction, energy и MBA Edinburgh Business School — с глубокой интеграцией в индустрию ОАЭ и глобальной сетью alumni Heriot-Watt.
